WONDER DAILY GRADE 2 · WRITING

Give one discovery a home.

A diamond's story. · Curiosity-led family day

Name __________________________ Date _______________

Choose a picture. Say what surprised you. Then draw or write one idea that you want to keep.

Draw one detail from your scene. Add an arrow or a label to help someone understand it.

carbon · crystal · heat · pressure · scratch · light · facet

Deep underground, … What helped the diamond crystal grow?

A diamond is hard to scratch, but … What could still happen to it?

The light … Where does its path begin? Where does it go?

Read it together. Point to the detail your words explain. If you are writing, check the first capital and the ending mark.

GROWN-UP NOTE About 15 min: 3 to choose and talk, 4 to draw, 6 for 1–3 sentences, 2 to read back. One careful idea is enough. Accept invented spelling, speech, or dictation. Help Leo keep his own phrasing.
